2609.01360.title: EDGE: Error Dependency Graph-Guided Multi-Error Attribution in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
2609.01360.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agent failures often contain multiple related errors rather than a single mistake. Existing attribution methods usually identify a responsible agent, step, or root cause, but do not explicitly model dependency between errors. We introduce EDGE, an Error Dependency Graph-guided multi-Error attribution framework. EDGE constructs an error dependency graph from observed error events and validates a reliable causal subset through counterfactual rollout. The inference graph guides a two-stage LLM-as-judge detector for error attribution, and the intervention-validated subgraph provides a more reliable basis for explanation and repair analysis. Experiments on TRAIL and MAST show that EDGE improves category-level multi-error attribution across most evaluated models and settings. Experiments with adapted Who&When-style prompts show that the graph helps across prompting strategies. These results suggest that dependency structure is a useful diagnostic prior for agent failures beyond isolated root-cause prediction.
2609.01360.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理的失敗通常包含多個相關錯誤，而不是單一的錯誤。現有的歸因方法通常識別出一個負責的代理、步驟或根本原因，但並未明確建模錯誤之間的依賴關係。我們介紹了EDGE，一種錯誤依賴圖引導的多錯誤歸因框架。EDGE從觀察到的錯誤事件構建錯誤依賴圖，並通過反事實展開驗證可靠的因果子集。推理圖引導一個兩階段的LLM作為判斷者的錯誤歸因檢測器，而干預驗證的子圖則為解釋和修復分析提供了更可靠的基礎。在TRAIL和MAST上的實驗顯示，EDGE在大多數評估模型和設置中改善了類別層級的多錯誤歸因。使用改編的Who&When風格提示的實驗顯示，該圖在提示策略中提供了幫助。這些結果表明，依賴結構是代理失敗的一個有用診斷先驗，超越了孤立的根本原因預測。
